gp.name: Limited local Golden Project

components.name: Disposable project bundle
components.spec: GP-local-v0.1: known project settings, named bins and a manifest of stable asset identities.
components.purpose: Open, save, dirty state, real process restart and CLI attachment.

components.name: Six small local media fixtures
components.spec: pattern_24.mov (ProRes, 12 s, 1080p24, stereo + frame marks); motion_25.mp4 (H.264, 8 s, 1080p25); speech.wav (8 s, 48 kHz); still.png (1080p); sample.mxf (6 s, 1080p25); mask.png (grayscale). Filenames are stubs.
components.purpose: Mixed import, metadata, source references, thumbnails, audio, relink, colour and export.

components.name: Known speech and search expectations
components.spec: speech.wav contains one recorded phrase and timed speech markers. Include a unique filename token and an absent search token. Pin the local ingest configuration.
components.purpose: Transcript generation, timestamp search and newly ingested search coverage.

components.name: Two short timelines
components.spec: Main at 24 fps with 2 video / 2 audio tracks, linked AV, one gap and overlapping clips; Secondary at 25 fps with a distinct asset. Variants are made in disposable copies.
components.purpose: Insert, overwrite, split, trim, slip, link, undo/redo, targeting and cross-rate copy.

components.name: One small compound
components.spec: Two existing fixture clips grouped into a compound with a known inner timeline.
components.purpose: Compound creation, inner edits and persistence.

components.name: Minimal colour graph
components.spec: A local source and supported colour node with a mask input. Expected graph topology and reference renders are versioned.
components.purpose: Node operations, colour changes, mask wiring and reversible edits.

components.name: Known grayscale mask
components.spec: Use mask.png from the media pack: half white, half black, with a narrow gray transition.
components.purpose: Check actual masked pixels, not only a successful graph connection.

components.name: One local Spellbook graph
components.spec: still.png → two supported local image effects → output. No external provider. Record graph parameters, output properties and retained result identity.
components.purpose: Graph edits, local execution, delivery to the bin and restart persistence.

excluded: External AI generation and live model checks
rules: Use a fresh disposable copy for independent tests.
Keep the source project and media pack read-only.
Record exact build, fixture version and test revision for every run.
Do not mark GP support as ready until the actual fixture and reference results are validated.
